standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial and cosimplicial objects
standard_prerequisites.statement: The categories of simplicial and of cosimplicial objects in a category, with their morphisms and the notion of homotopy between them.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are the objects of the four clauses of the statement (source lines 5224-5247).

standard_prerequisites.name: Homotopy in terms of the comparison categories
standard_prerequisites.statement: The description of the homotopy relation through the auxiliary categories of the author's remarks, which makes the relation manifestly functorial (the author's remark-homotopy-better and remark-homotopy-cosimplicial-better, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is where the substance of the proof lives (source lines 5254-5255).

standard_prerequisites.name: Reduction of a contravariant functor to a covariant one
standard_prerequisites.statement: A contravariant functor may be regarded as a covariant functor between the appropriate pair of categories (the author's lemma-compare-homotopies, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It reduces the four cases to the covariant ones (source lines 5252-5253).

core_obligations: Reduce to a covariant functor: use the comparison lemma to regard F as a covariant functor between a suitable pair of categories (source lines 5252-5254).
Apply the functoriality of the homotopy relation: conclude that a homotopic pair is carried to a homotopic pair, as explained in the author's remark (source lines 5254-5255).

Record that the four clauses are covered: the covariant statement for simplicial and cosimplicial objects and their contravariant counterparts, the target category switching from simplicial to cosimplicial in the contravariant case (source lines 5230-5248).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce the contravariant cases to covariant ones by the comparison lemma.
Conclude by the functoriality of the homotopy relation from the author's remark.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-functorial-homotopy at source lines 5222-5249: it states, in four cases (covariant or contravariant functor, simplicial or cosimplicial source), that a functor carries homotopic morphisms to homotopic morphisms, with the target changing from simplicial to cosimplicial when the functor is contravariant. The proof at source lines 5251-5256 is a two-sentence reduction: by the comparison lemma one may turn F into a covariant functor between a pair of categories, after which the assertion is the functoriality of the homotopy relation explained in the author's remark. The card therefore counts a four-case statement whose proof is a pointer to a carried remark; the retained context includes that remark and the comparison lemma, so the reduction is complete inside the package.
